note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our online store's conversion rate fell from 3.2% to 2.5% last month. We need to know where in the funnel customers drop off.

answers.common.decision: Which part of the checkout to fix first; the e-commerce lead decides.
answers.common.audience: The e-commerce lead and the web team.
answers.common.materials: We had 200,000 sessions last month. 40% of sessions reached a product page. Mobile is 70% of sessions.
answers.data-analytics.data: Web analytics export by device and funnel step.
answers.data-analytics.question: Where customers drop off and why conversion fell.
